stage: CPS-Prompt and REP-CODA implementation and CPU validation
approval_scope: Implement CPS, then native paper-based REP-CODA and a separate frozen-CODA control; CPU validation only

dataset.name: seq-cifar100-224
dataset.replay_and_auxiliary_transform_policy: Audit actual replay/statistics/herding paths, including Kornia conversion; never assume matching config implies bit-identical crops

common_future_protocol.pretraining: Pinned size-specific AugReg IN21K to IN1K canonical150 encoder tensors

native_adaptations: Reuse Mammoth CODA prompt pool and frozen canonical150 AugReg encoder
Own checkpointed sampling RNG, separate from data augmentation
Mammoth custom_scheduler lifecycle and accurate Class-IL compatibility
Joint phase must have at least one epoch; no silent phase skipping
CPU source operator fixtures are unmodified; source/native GPU accuracy validation remains pending
source_behavior: Joint prompt/head phase followed by no-grad full-patch features and head-only backward
Explicit attention in all source blocks; final query CLS-attention times full-width value norm
basis.fixture_policy: Preserve upstream bytes, including trailing whitespace; lint and native diff checks exclude these source fixtures

future_validation.matching: Use identical input batches, pinned encoder tensors and prompt/head initialization; retain original 10-task allocation

basis.implementation_basis: Native reconstruction from REP arXiv v6, applied to the existing CODA host
basis.upstream_license_observation: REP repository code is CC BY-NC4.0; this native paper reconstruction does not relabel or bundle that code as MIT

host_contract.query: Frozen Tiny with the same pinned IN21K-to-IN1K AugReg family
host_contract.optimizer_scheduler: Existing CODA Adam and task-wise cosine; common20-epoch recipe, not paper1875 iterations
host_contract.evaluation: All blocks execute, merging remains deterministic, query/projection remain enabled

explicit_reconstruction_choices: Gaussian fixed query projection192->D, divided by sqrt192; registered persistent buffer initialized with seed+1
Progressive local merge maximum16 is a configurable engineering default; the missing author runner does not establish r_max
ALD minimum=.5 and gamma=.001 follow public component defaults; alpha=.9 follows paper
Tiny spatial threshold8 and Base12 follow the paper; Small10 is an explicit adaptation
ALD uses the local planned merge count capped by currently available image tokens, then skips the whole block before execution
Use >= at the spatial threshold as Eq6; Algorithm2 prints >
First optimizer update executes every block, following full-keep initialization text; this is an explicit exception to Eq5 at t=0
Time is absolute optimizer-update count within the task, advanced once by observe and reset at a new task; gamma is not silently rescaled across batch sizes
AToM excludes CLS from matching and CODA prefix K/V are never in the image-token sequence
Weighted token masses become additive log attention biases; prefix keys have mass1
Native SDPA attention returns image-only mean-key metrics for merging
Checkpoint includes query weights, fixed projection, task/update counters and separate CPU ALD RNG state
No automatic sweep, auxiliary teacher, replay buffer, GPU run or inferred energy savings
source_issues_addressed: Replace hardcoded1024 projection width with the host encoder dimension
Persist projection instead of a lazy plain Tensor
Advance ALD timestep once per optimizer update, rather than per block or with a probability as the timestep
Explicitly activate progressive merging without an unavailable runner
Keep prefix keys separate from image tokens and align metrics/masses correctly
Use explicit native classes rather than source isinstance patching
Avoid source per-forward CUDA event/synchronize instrumentation
basis.accuracy_gate: CPU structural tests and paired host controls; the1.5/3pp independent-author accuracy gate remains pending a complete independent reference

future_validation.must_record: Update count and executed-block/merged-token traces; ALD decay is per update, so batch16/64 schedules differ

methods.swift_at_tiny_caveat: A separate frozen Tiny query is retained even with a Tiny host. It gives no smaller-encoder query FLOP saving there, adds storage/projection, and must be counted in efficiency measurements

methods.basis: Existing CODA behavior with explicitly frozen canonical encoder

future_efficiency_reporting.energy: Use the existing device telemetry during dedicated GPU measurements; do not infer energy from CPU debug logs
future_efficiency_reporting.publication: Local plus W&B laymond1/cl-efficiency and configured Slack notifications after a later launch decision

scope_boundary: Do not append these methods to or launch the held multi-method experiment batch in this implementation stage
